assumptions: Index titles drop the leading 'ADR NNNN — ' that 0016/0017 frontmatter titles carry, matching the existing 0001-0015 rows (which also drop it); the title text is otherwise verbatim.
The drift check compares number and status only, per the settled scope; titles are not asserted, so wording edits to a row do not fail the build.
The check lives in ts/test (run by the existing vitest gate) rather than a new workflow or scripts/lib module, so no entropy.entryPoints change is needed.
